# Absolute

Gives the absolute value of a number.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Absolute(value)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | number | The number. Null, or a value that is not a number, is a runtime error. |

## Returns

Number. The number without its sign: value itself when it is zero or more, and its negation when it is below zero. The result is exact when value is exact. Never null.

## Example

`Absolute(-3.5)` returns `3.5`.
